description: Generate (idempotently) the ZUGFeRD plan invoice PDF for a single subscription charge and return a 1-hour presigned download URL. First call allocates the invoice number (YYYY-NNNNNN), renders the PDF/A-3 with embedded EN 16931 XML, and uploads to S3; subsequent calls return a fresh presigned URL for the existing row. The user must own the underlying charge. Returns `{ invoiceNumber, downloadUrl }`.

chargeTransactionId.description: The SUBSCRIPTION_CHARGE Transaction id (from list_subscription_charges output).

name: get_subscription_invoice
